osha_event: Nonroadway noncollision  vehicle overturn

osha_event: Exposure through intact tissue

report: An employee was using a cordless drill to drill a hole when their glove became caught and their left little finger was pulled into the bit extension. The employee sustained an amputation to their fingertip.

report: An employee was working from a mobile scaffold when the walk board slipped out of place. The employee fell 10 feet and sustained a fractured right elbow.
osha_event: Fall to lower level from collapsing structure or equipment  6 to 30 feet

report: An employee was performing electrical work when his left arm was caught by a cable/wire pulling machine and pulled in. The employee sustained two fractures to the arm and amputation of two fingers.
osha_event: Caught, entangled in running powered equipment  normal operation

report: An employee was brazing copper lines together on a new air conditioning unit close to an access point in a brick wall, The two wires ran horizontally and copper tubing ran vertically. The heat from the brazing heated up the copper tubing. A wire was touching the copper tubing, causing the wire jacket to melt. The wire infused itself to the copper tubing, which energized the copper pipe. The employee was using a wet towel to cool down the copper tubing when he was electrically shocked, resulting in hospitalization.
osha_event: Indirect exposure to electricity  unspecified

report: On March 17, 2025, an employee was reinstalling the top of a fire hydrant. As he was tightening/rotating it, it crushed his left little finger. The finger was amputated.
osha_event: Contact with non-running objects or equipment  unspecified

report: An employee was preparing to make wire terminations in an electrical switchgear. The employee contacted exposed wires and was shocked and burned.
osha_event: Direct exposure to electricity, unspecified

report: An employee was installing rebar on a grandstand deck when he began experiencing lightheadedness and was hospitalized for heat-related illness and dehydration.
osha_event: Exposure to environmental heat  outdoor

report: An employee climbed off a ladder onto an aluminum roof when they slipped on wet leaves and fell 10 feet to a wooden deck. They sustained a fractured L1 vertebra.
osha_event: Other fall to lower level  6 to 30 feet

report: An employee was preparing to cut a beam and was removing overhead piping and conduit near a column during demolition work. While removing the overhead busbar (480-volts) with a reciprocating saw, the saw cut into the busbar and an arc flash occurred. The employee was electrocuted and sustained burns to their upper body and face.
osha_event: Exposure to electric arc

report: An employee was manually feeding a tagline to a crane when the tagline wrapped around his left little finger while being lifted by the crane, resulting in the amputation of the finger.
osha_event: Caught, entangled in running powered equipment  normal operation

report: An employee was near a concrete pump truck when it made contact with electrical transmission lines. The employee was shocked, suffering entry and exit wounds (with burns).
osha_event: Indirect exposure to electricity  greater than 220 volts

report: An employee was cutting joints out of acid bricks below the manway door inside a tower. He lost his balance and as he went to catch himself, the grinder he was holding lacerated the top of his left hand.
osha_event: Injured by slipping or swinging object held by injured worker

report: An employee was working with lightweight insulation on a flat commercial roof. The employee became ill/dehydrated due to the temperature and humidity.
osha_event: Exposure to environmental heat  outdoor

report: An employee was servicing a customer's electrical panel. When going to close the panel door, the employee went to push wires into the panel and sustained an electric shock and burns to their middle, ring and little fingers. The little fingertip was amputated and the ring finger required surgery.
osha_event: Direct exposure to electricity  unspecified

report: One employee was sawing a wall while the injured employee was vacuuming water behind the section that was being cut. The wall fell down when the saw was removed from the wall and struck the injured employee, resulting in a broken arm and jaw.
osha_event: Collapse, engulfment  building or structure

report: An employee was performing plumbing services at a residential home when they were splashed in the eyes by an alkaline drain clog remover. The employee sustained chemical burns.
osha_event: Exposure through intact skin, eyes, or other exposed tissue

report: An employee was using the pipe-and-wrench method to loosen a seized bolt on a roof truss. A technician from another company was on the other side of the truss doing the same action with the same method. The employee's socket slipped off the bolt and his left hand was crushed against the truss, resulting in injuries to the index and little fingers, requiring hospitalization, surgery, and amputation of the index finger.
osha_event: Injured by object held or wielded by person

report: An employee was setting up trench boxes for a sewer construction job. While unhooking the chain from a trench box that had been lowered into the ground, his right thumb was crushed between the chain and the trench box. The employee was taken to the hospital, where he underwent surgery for a partial amputation to his right thumb.
osha_event: Compressed or pinched by shifting objects or equipment

report: An employee was climbing a mounted ladder inside a store to access the roof when they slipped and fell approximately 10 feet to the floor below. The employee sustained heel fractures to both feet.
osha_event: Other fall to lower level  6 to 30 feet

report: An employee was gathering tools and materials to grind, sack, and patch a concrete pad under the magnesium chloride tank. The employee was using a hand grinder when the grinding stone shattered and debris struck the employee on the left inner thigh, resulting in a puncture and bruising.
osha_event: Struck by dislodged flying object, particle

report: An employee was on the third or fourth rung of a 10-foot ladder removing a 277-volt LED lighting fixture from the ceiling. The employee was shocked, causing him to fall off the ladder onto the floor. He sustained facial fractures.
osha_event: Other fall to lower level 6 to 10 feet

report: An employee was dismounting an excavator when he missed a step, lost his balance, and fell onto a pile of concrete rubble. He struck his right hip and his right femur was fractured near the hip joint. The employee required surgery.
osha_event: Other fall to lower level  unspecified

report: The injured employee was operating a boring machine. Another employee was operating an excavator. The excavator bucket came in contact with the injured employee, resulting in a pelvic fracture when they were pinned against the boring machine. The employee was hospitalized.
osha_event: Compressed between running equipment and other object(s)

report: An employee was unhooking the ramps to an equipment trailer in preparation for unloading equipment. The employee engaged the pneumatic system to lower the ramp. He walked around the back of the trailer and the ramp fell down and pinned him to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to his T5 and T7 to T11 vertebrae, three fractured ribs on the left side, a punctured lung, and severe bruising of his left side and hip. The employee was hospitalized.
osha_event: Struck by falling part of vehicle or machine, still attached

report: An employee was walking through a building when they tripped on a 6-inch-long wire and fell, resulting in a fractured knee.
osha_event: Fall on same level due to slip or trip
